decisions: Use complete source XML, not a dictionary keyed only by Strong’s number.
NFC/case headword matching only; no accent stripping, hyphen removal, inferred synonyms or article-only aliases.
Preserve extended Strong’s suffixes, multi-number identifiers and separate entries with shared numbers.
Retain literal historical citations, sense labels and abbreviations. Layout whitespace/page breaks normalized; source NT count notes stored separately from prose.
No Tischendorf text, morphology or frequency data is attached to current Scripture. No current analysis/corpus release changes.
